key_rules: GOLDEN RULE: Content-first classification — NEVER classify invoices by prefix, partner name, or assumptions. Always read the actual PDF/XLSX content first.
3-Layer Cost Model: L0 (Factory COGS) + L1 (Factory→3PL: ocean freight, duties, rail, inbound) + L2 (3PL→FBA: transfer prep, freight, placement)
CBM-weighted allocation: Cost split across products using Master Box Volume ratios, never flat per-unit
ALL non-Monta 3PL costs = COGS (Amazon FBA). Only Monta = webshop operations (overhead).
ALL 3PL storage/rent = Overhead across all partners, never COGS
TO/PO matching is mandatory: Every invoice must link to specific TO or PO. Cost/unit only shown when matched.
Products JSON must always be populated when TO/PO is linked — never NULL
Sellerboard format: XLSX with D/MM/YYYY dates, CostPeriodStartDate = 1/01/2000. EU in EUR, US in USD (€1=$1.087).
Git workflow: Always feature branches + PR, never push to main directly (Directive #29)
No Slack for COGS — everything through Vercel app only
Every new invoice uploaded to Google Drive folder 15zTNC3cdtKD5v6ADRVw8MqN62J-eaPP2 with pdf_drive_id stored
Airtable is fully deprecated for COGS — all data in Supabase
